AppSubtitle: Automatic library of GitHub repositories saved and versioned exclusively as .zip archives
OpenLibraryTooltip: Open the main folder where all repository folders and .zip versions are stored
CategoryComboTooltip: Choose or type a new category to classify the repository
SortFilterTooltip: Sort repositories by Recent, Stars, A-Z, Z-A, or Size
EmptyStateDesc: Paste any GitHub repository URL above and choose its category. The app will automatically download the .zip package to the repository folder and keep all versions saved.
CardChangeCategoryTooltip: Click to change or create a new category for this repository
CardOpenDetailsTooltip: Click to view full details and update notes for this repository
CardCreateProjectTooltip: Extract the selected .zip version into a new project folder of your choice
CardSyncTooltip: Check for updates and download new .zip
CardOpenZipsTooltip: Open this repository's folder containing saved .zip archives
FooterReadyStatus: Ready • Background monitoring active in the Windows system tray
NewCategoryPromptLabel: Enter the category name for this card:
SettingsSubtitle: Configure language, background behavior, .zip library path, and auto-updates.
SettingsDailyScheduleInfo: Repositories are checked automatically once a day (on the first time the app runs in the day).
SettingsStartWithWindows: Start automatically with Windows (auto-register in system tray)
SettingsMinimizeToTray: Keep running in the background in the system tray when closing the window (X)
SettingsGitHubTokenLabel: GitHub Personal Access Token (Optional — prevents rate limits and allows private repos):
